
---

### Install
- **Windows 10 / 11:** download `Quran_<version>_x64-setup.exe`. It installs for your user only. SmartScreen may warn because the app is not code-signed yet: choose **More info → Run anyway**.
- **macOS:** download `Quran_<version>_universal.dmg`.
- **Already installed?** Open **Settings → Updates**; the new version downloads in the background.

Free and open source (GPL-3.0), no ads. Please report anything that looks wrong, especially in the Arabic text, in [Issues](https://github.com/Obscyra/quran-desktop/issues).
